book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn MARK

content: Sises Katungoale Aramas Pahkid
Pokon kalaimwun ehu ahpw pil pwurehng wiawi rehn Sises rahn ehu, ahpw sohte me re en tungoale. Ih eri malipepene sapwellime tohnpadahk ko oh mahsanihong irail,
“I poakelahr pokon wet, pwe rahnehr siluh re mihmihki rehi, a met solahr me re en tungoale.
Ma I pahn kadarihralahng ni imwarail kan sohte tungoale mehkot, re kakete lipwongmasala nanial akan, pwe ekei irail kohdo sang wasa doh.”
Sapwellime tohnpadahk ko ahpw idek, patohwan, “Aramas pahn kihsang ia nan sapwtehn wet kisin tungoal me pahn itarohng katungoale soangen lapalahn pokon wet?”
Sises ketin keinemwe rehrail, mahsanih, “Lopwon en pilawa depe mie rehmwail?” A irail sapeng, patohwan, “Me isuh.”

Sises eri mahsanih pwe pokono en mwohndiong pohn reh kan. E ahpw ketikihda lopwon en pilawa isuhwo, kapingkalahngankiong Koht, pilitikihpeseng oh ketikihong sapwellime tohnpadahk ko pwe re en nehkohng pokono. Irail eri nehkpeseng.
Kisin mwomw kei pil mie rehrail; Sises eri pil loulouki oh mahsanihong tohnpadahk ko re en pil nehkohng irail.
Pokono eri kepin konot oh medla—irail koaros kereniong aramas pahkid.
Tohnpadahk ko eri deukada kopwou isuh dir, luhwen konoto. Sises ahpw ketin kadarpeseng pokono,
oh ketidahng pohn pwoht ehu oh douluhllahng nan wehin Dalmanuda.
Parisi ko Peki Manaman ehu sang rehn Sises
Parisi kei ahpw patohdo oh tapihada akpwungiong Sises. Re men widingehdi, iei me re pekihki en wiahda ehu manamanen sang nanleng, kadehdepen en Koht eh ketiket reh.
Sises ahpw ketin asmoamoarada oh mahsanih, “Dahme aramas en ahnsou wet kan kin pekihki manaman ehu sang nanleng? Kumwail en ese me sohte manaman ehu pahn kohieng dih wet!”
Ih eri ketiketla sang irail, pwurehng ketidahng pohn pwohto sipallahng palio leho.
Ihsen Parisi ko oh Ihsen Erod
Tohnpadahk ko manokehla wahda lopwon en pilawa kei ar mehn kepinwar; lopwon en pilawateieu me mie rehrail pohn pwohto.
Sises eri ketin kehkehlingkihong irail, mahsanih, “Kumwail kalekeikumwailsang ihsen Parisi kan oh pil en Erod.”
Irail eri tapihada koasoiapene nanpwungarail, ndinda, “Pwehki eh sohte pilawa rehtail me e mahsaniheki met.”

Sises mwahngihada dahme re ndindao, ihme e keinemwehki rehrail, “Dahme kumwail koasoakoasoiahki dene sohte pilawa rehmwail? Kumwail saikinte marainla oh esehla soahng kan? Kumwail meid nan kapehd rotorot!
Mie pwoaren masamwail—a dahme kumwail sohte kak kilangki wasa? Mie salengamwail—a dahme kumwail sohte kak rongki wasa?
De kumwail manokelahr duwen ei pilitikihpeseng lopwon en pilawa limawo me nehnehiong aramas limekido? Kopwou depe kumwail deukada sang luhwen konoto?” Irail patohwanohng, “Me eisek riau.”
“A pilawa isuhwo me I pilitikihpeseng pwe en nehnehiong aramas pahkido? Kopwou depe kumwail deukada sang luhwen konoto?” Irail patohwanohng, “Me isuh.”
A e keinemwe rehrail, “A dahme kumwail sohte dehdehkihki?”
Sises Kakehlahda Ohlen Pedsaida men me Maskun
Irail eri ketin lel Pedsaida; wasao aramas kei ahpw kahredohng Sises ohl maskun men oh peki en ketin doahke.
Sises eri ketin ale pehn me maskuno oh kahrelahng likin kahnimwo. Mwurin eh ketin likidiong pohn pwoaren mese ko oh ketikidahng lime ko pohn ohlo, e keinemwe ma e kilangehr wasa de soh.
Me maskuno eri pehdpeseng oh patohwanohng Sises, “Maing, I kak patohwan aramas akan, ahpw likamwete tuhke kei me alialuseli.”
Sises pil pwurehng ketikihda lime ko ni pwoaren mese ko, ohlo ahpw pwurehng pehdpeseng; a met ahpw mwahula, e kakehr kilangada mehkoaros mwahu.
Sises eri ketin kadarala ni imweo, mahsanih, “Kohwei ni imwomwo, oh ke dehpa pwurala nan kahnimwo.”
En Piter eh Kasalehda duwen Sises
Sises oh sapwellime tohnpadahk ko ahpw ketieilahng nan kahnimw en Sisaria Pilipai. E ahpw ketin keinemwe rehrail nanialo, mahsanih, “Dahme aramas akan kin ndinda duwen ngehi? Ihs ngehi?”
Irail eri sapeng, patohwanohng, “Ekei kin patohwan me komwi Sohn Sounpapidais, ekei me komwi Elaisa, a ekei me komwi emen soukohp en kawa ko.”
A e ahpw keinemwe rehrail, “A kumwail, ihs me kumwail wiahkin ie?” Piter ahpw sapeng, patohwanohng, “Komwi me Mesaiao.”
Sises eri ketin kalikiraildi pwe re dehr ndaiong emen met.
Sises Mahsanih duwen Eh pahn Lokolok oh Pwoula

Sises eri tapihada kawehwehiong sapwellime tohnpadahk ko duwen Nein-Aramas eh uhdahn pahn lokolok oh sekenikenla pahn soumas oh samworo lapalap ako oh sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo ko. E pahn kemakamala, oh mwurin rahn siluh e pahn iasada.
E ketin mahsanih mepwukat ni sansal. Piter eri kahrehsang Sises wasao oh tapihada kapwungohng.
A Sises ketin sohpeisang oh ketin mahmahsanihseli sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, ketin angiangihada Piter, mahsanih, “Kohla mwuri, Sehdan, pwe omw lamalamen, kaidehn sapwellimen Koht pwe en aramas.”
Sises eri ketin kapokonepene aramas ngeder oh sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, oh mahsanihong irail, “Mehmen me men iengiehla, en tounmeteikihla pein ih, kapaikada eh lohpwu oh idawehniehdo.
Pwe me pahn kin kanakanai eh mour, pahn pwupwusang; a me pahn kesehla eh mour pwehki ngehi oh pwehki rongamwahu, e pahn komourla.
Pwe ia pahn katepehiong aramas, ma e pahn sapwenikihla sampah pokon, e ahpw katihasang uhdahn eh mour?
Dahme emen kak kihda pwe en pwurehng eh mour?

Eri, mehmen me pahn namenengkin ie oh ei padahk rehn aramas en dih suwed oh dipan wet, ih me Nein-Aramas pahn pil ketin ailehki ni eh pahn ketido ni lingan en Seme iangahki sapwellime tohnleng sarawi kan.”
